name: Tobijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Take of them of the captivity, of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.

note.label: Zechariah 6: The Four Chariots and the Crowning of Joshua
